regimeSub: Yields resume bear steepening with 10Y breaching 5% as Warsh's hawkish stance meets sticky 3.7% CPI.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh's Sept 16 hike to 4.0% now fully priced → 2Y spikes 9bps to 4.76% from 4.67% as market reprices terminal rate higher after 'more tightening ahead' guidance
10Y breaks psychological 5% barrier at 5.01% → 25bps 2s10s steepening from last week reflects fiscal premium + Warsh credibility concerns on 3.7% Aug CPI vs 3.5% prior
BOK under acute pressure as Korea-US rate gap holds at 100bps post-Fed hike → USDKRW eases to 1359 from 1382 but BOK forced into reactive hiking cycle per Korea Times reporting
Brent at $97.27 with Hormuz war-risk premium sticky despite June interim US-Iran deal → oil floor constrains disinflation path, VIX complacent at 14.87 signals equity mispricing of stagflation risk
